item.title: fix(gateway): prevent large history from blocking chat startup (#124994)
item.summary: fix(gateway): prevent large history from blocking chat startup (#124994) * fix(gateway): bound startup history materialization Apply SQLite byte limits before loading history payloads and share a yielded, fingerprinted Claude CLI snapshot across concurrent startup clients. Preserve marker, cursor, redaction, and external identity semantics, and clarify that shrink-only ratchet updates need no separate approval. * test(browser): await all lazy command groups * fix(gateway): bound history snapshot state * fix(gateway): preserve oversized history responsiveness
